reason_codes.capture-authority-secondary: The legacy Makefile beside the vendored CMakeLists.txt compiles the same sources, so discovery keeps it as a parallel unit with capture_authority=secondary and parallel_with the CMake owner (plan §2.1 decision 2). The plan does not yet read capture_authority: it treats the secondary unit as an independent root and dispatches it standalone instead of containing it under the authority (T-035/T-036).
reason_codes.ownership-vendored: A nested Make tree whose rules compile another directory's sources (tinylib/test) stays a unit of its own until a literal drive names it: the parent CMake tree adds third_party/tinylib (folded into the parent, plan §2.1 decision 1), not tinylib/test, so the test Makefile is an independent root and is dispatched standalone, where its ../ sources are absent.
reason_codes.workspace-materialization: A unit's build workspace is its own root plus named dependency_files. A driver that references ../ paths needs the common ancestor of every referenced path materialized, and validate_build_recipe cannot accept dependency paths outside the unit's descriptor package, so the requirement cannot even be expressed.
reason_codes.deterministic-recipe: Recipes are entirely model-inferred. Canonical build systems (CMake with project(), Make default goal, a Cargo workspace, go.work, an npm build script, composer) have no deterministic recipe path, so accepted plans carry null recipes and recipe_missing refinements.
reason_codes.build-mode-disposition: The plan records no per-component build mode. Components that cannot or must not be built (Unity with unity.enabled=false, an Xcode project without xcodebuild, Gradle without an offline plugin cache or SDK image, a PHP tree without composer) surface as per-unit BLOCKED gaps mid-build instead of a plan-time disposition.
reason_codes.relation-workspace-member: Path dependencies between workspace members (Cargo path =, Go use/replace, an npm workspace dependency) are not recorded as relations in the graph, so member build order inside the workspace is unknown to the plan.
reason_codes.relation-gradle-module: Gradle project(':lib') references use colon module notation; the path resolver rejects a colon, so the relation stays unresolved instead of binding the sibling module declared by settings.gradle.
reason_codes.swift-policy-disabled: Discovery finds the Xcode project (swift/xcodebuild, language swift; job pass 05) but the plan's Swift policy (tools.enable_swift=false) removes Swift-derived units from every executable planning input, so the plan does not carry it. The unit reaches planning only when the policy is enabled; a build-mode disposition (unsupported_platform) is still owed for the source-only component.

shapes.name: parent-cmake-vendored
shapes.summary: A CMake application that vendors a library with its own CMakeLists.txt, a legacy standalone Makefile and a test/ Makefile whose sources are ../src/*.c. The parent is the only build driver. The vendored CMakeLists.txt is folded into the parent on the add_subdirectory evidence (plan §2.1 decision 1, 2026-11-08).

shapes.name: sibling-include
shapes.summary: A Makefile under tools/packer that compiles main.c together with ../../common/src/util.c and includes ../../common/include/util.h. A workspace holding only tools/packer cannot build it; one holding the repository root can.

shapes.name: cargo-workspace
shapes.summary: A Cargo workspace with two crates; cli depends on core by path. The workspace root is the only build root and the recipe runs there. Members are folded into the workspace root as its build points (plan §2.1 decision 1, 2026-11-08): never units.

shapes.name: go-workspace
shapes.summary: A go.work workspace with two modules; svc imports shared through the workspace (and a replace directive for standalone builds). The workspace root is the only build root. Members are folded into the workspace root as its build points (plan §2.1 decision 1, 2026-11-08): never units.

shapes.name: npm-workspace
shapes.summary: An npm workspace with two packages and no external dependencies; the root build script runs node build.js. The workspace root is the only build root. Members are folded into the workspace root as its build points (plan §2.1 decision 1, 2026-11-08): never units.

shapes.name: unity-client
shapes.summary: A Unity project (ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt, Packages/manifest.json, one script). Discovered as an engine project; not built while unity.enabled is false; source analysis still applies.

shapes.name: ios-xcode
shapes.summary: An Xcode project with one Swift source. No Linux image can build it; it is a source-only, unsupported-platform component and must never be dispatched.

components.build_mode_reason: xcodebuild and the iOS SDK are not available in any pinned Linux build image

shapes.name: android-gradle
shapes.summary: A multi-module Gradle project: settings.gradle includes :app (com.android.application) and :lib (com.android.library); no root build.gradle and no wrapper jar. One component rooted at the settings file. The included projects are folded into the settings root as its build points (plan §2.1 decision 1, 2026-11-08).

components.build_mode_reason: no Gradle wrapper, no offline plugin cache and no SDK image declared for the Android Gradle plugin; a networked Gradle build is not a permitted recipe

shapes.name: php-site
shapes.summary: A PHP tree with two parts: public/ has no composer.json and is a source-only scope with no build unit; lib/ has composer.json and is a package-only unit.

components.build_mode_reason: no composer.json or other build descriptor; interpreted sources are analyzed without a build

shapes.name: nested-conditional-root
shapes.summary: A CMakeLists.txt without project() that the parent includes only under option(SERVER_BUILD_EXAMPLES) defaulting OFF. It has exactly one possible owner and is never an independent root; contained (conditional) rather than unresolved, because unresolved invites standalone recipe inference for a tree that cannot build alone. Under plan §2.1 decision 1 the conditionally added directory is folded into the parent with the condition on the drive; it is never a unit.

shapes.name: second-native-root
shapes.summary: A self-contained CMake project nothing else references: the control proving the fixture is not one component.
